label: Debtor days
short_definition: Accounts receivable relative to annual revenue, expressed in days.

label: Inventory days
short_definition: Inventory relative to annual cost of revenue, expressed in days.
formula_description: (Inventory / Cost of Revenue) x 365, FY only

label: Payables days
short_definition: Accounts payable relative to annual cost of revenue, expressed in days.
formula_description: (Accounts Payable / Cost of Revenue) x 365, FY only

label: Cash conversion cycle
short_definition: Debtor days plus inventory days less payables days.
formula_description: Debtor Days + Inventory Days - Payables Days, most recent FY each. Computed in expanded_metrics.py -- combines three METRIC outputs, not raw concepts, same pattern as net_debt_ebitda.
